Cultist

Internal ID: Fenring_Cultist | Faction: Mountain | Main biome: Mountain | Drops: Red jute | Cultist trophy | Abilities: Fireclaw double (10s), Fireclaw (2s), Flames (10s) | Trophy: Cultist trophy | Weak to (x1.5): Poison | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pierce, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning, ,, Spirit, ,, Stagger | Immune to (x0): Fire, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe | Stagger limit: 50%

Introduction. Cultists are aggressive creatures found in Mountains inside Frost Caves. Their appearance is distinctly werewolf-like, however, unlike Fenrings and Ulvs, they wear tattered red hooded cloaks.

Fireclaw double. The exact same as Fireclaw[1], but swings a second time with its other hand and has a 10-second cooldown (35 Slash 40 Fire damage each hit).

Fireclaw. Swings its claw in a 90-degree horizontal arc that is 3 meters long to scratch the player, which applies the Burning status (35 Slash 40 Fire damage). This attack has a 2-second cooldown and can be used within 1.5 meters of the player.

Flames. Brings both arms down before sending out a blast of fire which applies the Burning status (50 Fire damage). It hits in a 4-meter 35-degree horizontal arc and can hit through walls. This attack cannot be blocked, has a cooldown of 10 seconds, and can be used 2–6 meters from a player; it cannot be used if the player stands close.
